changelog: 1.0.29: requests and watchlist still shape taste but never push their own title: a requested title is held back on arrival and may come back if it stays unwatched; the top of the list now holds what is new in what the account follows (new episodes of a series it watched or liked, the next part of a saga), never its own requests; a thumb or favourite on a title never played here counts half; bulk "mark as watched" no longer makes old titles look recent (real last play from Playback Reporting); fuller "Because you liked" rows; short films left out of outside-the-library suggestions; faster single-account recomputes.
description: Personal recommendations that replace Jellyfin's own.
name: Reco+
overview: Personal recommendations (full history, abandoned titles, sagas, Seerr requests, extended mode).
